messages.author: c2a4124666613378
messages.subject: Vim-R-plugin: executing knitr chunk?
parts:
This may be a little bit off-topic, but does anyone know if it's possible to execute a knitr code chunk using vim with the Vim-R-plugin?

Running selected lines, etc. in an R markdown file works fine, but I was hoping to have something similar to RStudio's chunk execution (alt + cntl + c). The plugin has a 'send block' option (e.g. \bb), but that doesn't work in this case.

Any suggestions?

Thanks,
Keith

messages.author: 8c8f0ca54c4a2459
messages.subject: Re: Vim-R-plugin: executing knitr chunk?
parts:
The default "send chunk" keybinding in the current version of Vim-R-Plugin is `\cc` . See https://github.com/jcfaria/Vim-R-plugin/blob/master/doc/r-plugin.txt#L380 for related shortcuts.

Noam
